releases.name: v0.2.0 — First release: bilingual CLI, English-first docs
releases.notes:
**pixellogo 0.2.0** is the first tagged release: a command line tool that turns a title, a few subtitle lines and a footnote into real 8-bit / retro-terminal pixel art — PNG and SVG from the same geometry, five canvases, ten palettes, and mixed Latin / Chinese / Japanese / Korean text without missing glyphs.

## Highlights

- **Real pixels, not a filter.** Text is rasterized into a binary mask and merged per row into integer-coordinate rectangles. Every edge stays a whole block at any zoom: no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no feathering.
- **One geometry, two formats.** PNG and SVG are produced from the same `Scene`, so they match pixel for pixel. The SVG is self-contained and needs no font files.
- **Five canvases.** `poster` 1080×1440, `card` 1440×1080, `banner` 1280×640, `slide` 1920×1080, `square` 1080×1080, each with its own layout strategy.
- **Ten palettes.** From retro terminal to paper journal; every preset passes a WCAG contrast check (`--list presets` prints the ratio).
- **CJK-ready.** A Chinese pixel font ships in the box, so mixed Latin/Chinese lines keep one stroke weight; Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean download on demand.
- **Bilingual CLI.** Help page, option tables, font status, warnings and errors in English or Simplified Chinese — automatic from the terminal locale, or forced with `--ui-lang`.
- **No browser dependency.** Pure Python and Pillow rasterization; runs on servers and in CI.
- **Reusable configuration.** JSONC files with comments and trailing commas, dot-path overrides, batch mode, and a `--dry-run` snapshot of the merged result.

## New in 0.2.0

### Bilingual command line

All terminal output now exists in English and Simplified Chinese: the help page, `--list modes|presets|fonts`, `fonts` status, warnings, and every error message (including argparse's own argument errors).

- Automatic: `LC_ALL` → `LC_MESSAGES` → `LANG` → `LANGUAGE` → Windows UI language → English. `C` / `POSIX` count as English.
- Explicit: `--ui-lang auto|en|zh` for a single run, or `PIXELLOGO_UI_LANG` as a persistent default. Precedence is flag > environment > locale.
- `--ui-lang` (CLI wording) is independent of `--lang` (glyph variant used for the image): `--ui-lang en --lang ja` gives an English interface with Japanese glyphs.

### English-first documentation

- `README.md` is now English and is the default entry point.
- `README.zh-CN.md` holds the Chinese version; the two are cross-linked.
- `pyproject.toml` metadata and the GitHub repository description are in English.

### Packaging and robustness

- Built distribution: wheel, source distribution, and a portable zip (see the asset table below).
- Missing Pillow no longer breaks the query commands: if Pillow is absent, `--version`, `--help`, `--list` and `fonts` still work, and rendering exits with code `2` plus an instruction to install it.

## Install

From this release:

```bash
pipx install pixellogo-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
# or
pip install pixellogo-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

From source at this tag:

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit.git@v0.2.0
```

## Release assets

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `pixellogo-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` | Wheel. `pip install` this for a normal install; it adds the `pixellogo` command and bundles the five fonts, license texts and JSON schema. |
| `pixellogo-0.2.0.tar.gz` | Source distribution (sdist), for packagers or `pip install` from source. |
| `pixellogo-0.2.0-portable.zip` | No installation needed. Unpack and run `pixellogo.cmd` (Windows) or `./pixellogo.sh` (macOS / Linux). Contains the package, fonts, licenses, both READMEs and `RUNNING.txt`. |

GitHub also generates "Source code (zip)" and "Source code (tar.gz)" archives for every release. Those are raw repository snapshots and contain no built package — use the assets above if you just want to install and run the tool.

## Quick start

```bash
# One cover image, both formats, into out/
pixellogo -t "REA" -s "REVERSE ENGINEER" -d "One CLI for agents"

# A 16:9 slide cover in the cyber palette with a grid texture
pixellogo -t "PIXEL" -m slide -p cyber --bg-pattern grid

# Inspect what is available
pixellogo --list modes
pixellogo --list presets
pixellogo fonts
```

Running `pixellogo` with no arguments prints the help page; `--help`, `-h` and `pixellogo help` are equivalent.

## Command line at a glance

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `-t, --title` | Main title (required) |
| `-s, --subtitle` / `-d, --desc` | Subtitle and footnote lines, one flag per line |
| `-m, --mode` | `poster` / `card` / `banner` / `slide` / `square` |
| `-p, --preset` | One of the ten palettes |
| `--bg` `--fg` `--primary` `--accent` `--shadow-color` | Single-color overrides |
| `-f, --format` | `png` / `svg` / `both` (default `both`) |
| `-o, --out` | Output file or directory |
| `-c, --config` / `--set` | JSONC config and dot-path overrides |
| `--ui-lang` | CLI output language: `auto` / `en` / `zh` |
| `--lang` | Glyph variant: `zh-hans` / `zh-hant` / `ja` / `ko` |
| `--json` / `--dry-run` / `--open` | Machine-readable output / merged config / open the result |

Exit codes: `0` success, `2` invalid arguments or configuration.

## Python API

```python
from pixellogo import render, make_image, make_scene, to_svg_text

paths = render(title="REA", mode="banner", preset="cyber", format="png", out="out/")
image = make_image(title="REA", mode="square", scale=1)
scene = make_scene(title="REA", mode="poster")
svg = to_svg_text(title="REA", mode="slide")
```

Keyword names match the JSONC config keys exactly, so anything valid in a config file is valid here.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9 or newer
- Pillow 9.0 or newer (only runtime dependency)

## Testing

- 143 unit and integration tests (`PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- CI runs the suite on Python 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12, plus a job that renders real images on Linux.

## Known limitations…

releases.name: 3.0.1 — enforced candidate menu, per-source chains, comparing gate
releases.notes:
## What changed

3.0.1 closes the gap between what the README promised and what the code enforced. The short version: a Go model id can no longer be invented, chain length follows the source, Markdown agents can actually be written, the mode question is asked once, and `check` re-derives the numbers instead of trusting the file.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301---2026-11-03) for the full list. The Chinese changelog is at [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md).

## Install this release

Download **`opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip`** below. It is the minimal package, not the GitHub "source code" archive:

- top-level directory is `opencode-go-model-picker/`
- it contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/` and `LICENSE` — no tests, no docs site, no `assets/`, no `.git`, no `node_modules`
- 18 files

Extract it into your OpenCode skills directory so the folder name matches the skill name:

```bash
unzip opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -d ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```powershell
Expand-Archive opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -DestinationPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\skills"
```

Then ask OpenCode to check your agent models. The skill is read-only until you confirm a diff.

Requirements: Node.js 22+ (Node 18+ for everything except the local usage DB read), and OpenCode with Agent Skills support.

## Chinese documentation

- [README-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/README-ZH.md)
- [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md)

## Verification

- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 29 pass, 0 fail
- `node tools/check-docs.mjs` — 0 errors, 0 warnings
- the extracted package: `node --check` on every script, and `node scripts/go.mjs run --offline --json` against a real config (8 agents, 38 candidates, `quality=seed`)

en.headline: 74 own commits plus 25 automated commits across five repositories
en.summary: **74 own commits** were made across five repositories, plus 25 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, work covered bilingual CLI output, on-demand multilingual glyph variants, Korean font handling, layout fixes, and expanded documentation with a 40-image example gallery. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, the `plain-language` skill was tightened and converted to the OpenCode format, while `AGENTS.md` gained branch, chapter-commit, and post-merge push guidance and the knowledge role roster was updated. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, the `starlight-docs` skill gained template resources and a `detect`/`scaffold`/`check`/`audit`/`emit-check` script skeleton, the mobile splash controls were restored, and external-link checks were regraded to avoid proxy and offline false positives. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, release notes were fully fed into AI with a collapsible default page, and daily/summary wording was corrected to describe issue and PR counts by action count. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, the candidate menu, per-source chains, and comparing check gate were enforced, with caveat wording allowed to be reworded while the gate fails closed. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or discussions were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: The first tagged release introduces a bilingual CLI that renders titles, subtitles, and footnotes as 8-bit pixel art in PNG and SVG from one shared geometry. It adds five canvas sizes, ten WCAG-checked palettes, bundled Chinese pixel fonts with on-demand Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean variants, and a `--ui-lang auto|en|zh` option independent of the image glyph `--lang` option. Documentation is now English-first with `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md`, and query commands such as `--version`, `--help`, `--list`, and `fonts` still work when Pillow is missing while rendering exits with code `2`.

This release enforces the candidate menu, per-source chains, and a comparing check gate so Go model IDs cannot be invented and chain length follows the source. The caveat section may be reworded, while a flagless check is treated as structural and the gate fails closed. The minimal package `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip` contains 18 files limited to `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `LICENSE`, and verification reports 29 passing tests, 0 documentation errors, and 0 warnings.

zh.headline: 74 次本人提交，另有 25 次自动提交，覆盖五个仓库
zh.summary: 当日在五个仓库完成 **74 次本人提交**，另有 25 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 推进了中英双语命令行、按需下载的多语言字形变体、韩语字体处理与布局修复，并补充含 40 张图片的示例画廊。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 收紧并改造了 `plain-language` skill，`AGENTS.md` 增加分支、分章提交与合并后推送要求，知识角色名册也同步更新。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 为 `starlight-docs` 增加模板资源和 `detect`/`scaffold`/`check`/`audit`/`emit-check` 脚本骨架，恢复手机端 splash 页控件，并按失败原因分级外链检查以避免代理和离线误报。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 将 release notes 全量喂入 AI 并让页面默认收起可展开，同时修正日报与摘要中按动作数表述 issue 和 PR 计数。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 落实候选菜单、逐来源链和 comparing 检查门禁，允许 caveat 措辞改写，并让门禁失败即拦截。当天没有 pull request、issue、review 或讨论记录。

releaseNotes.summary: 首个带标签版本推出双语命令行，可将标题、副标题和脚注渲染为 8-bit 像素画，PNG 与 SVG 共用同一套几何结构。版本提供五种画布尺寸、十套通过 WCAG 对比度检查的调色板、内置中文像素字体，并按需下载繁体中文、日文和韩文字形；`--ui-lang auto|en|zh` 控制界面语言，与图像字形的 `--lang` 相互独立。文档改为英文优先的 `README.md` 与 `README.zh-CN.md`，缺少 Pillow 时 `--version`、`--help`、`--list` 和 `fonts` 等查询命令仍可使用，渲染则以退出码 `2` 终止。

该版本落实候选菜单、逐来源链和 comparing 检查门禁，使 Go 模型 ID 无法被臆造，链长度随来源而定。caveat 段落允许改写，无 flag 的检查被视为结构性问题，门禁采用失败即拦截的方式。最小包 `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip` 含 18 个文件，仅包含 `SKILL.md`、`references/`、`scripts/` 和 `LICENSE`；验证结果为 29 项测试通过、文档检查 0 错误 0 警告。
